> Hello to all contributors and many thanks for this very useful R
> package !

> spectrogram (e.g. with mic input) using seewave, please ?
> Thanks a lot
> Matthias
>

Well, there might be a way as you can do live recording with the
function record() of the package audio and monitor the recording. Here
is the example of that function :

library(audio)
x <- rep(NA_real_, 16000)
# start recording into x
record(x, 8000, 1)
# monitor the recording progress
par(ask=FALSE) # for continuous plotting
while (is.na(x[length(x)])) plot(x, type='l', ylim=c(-1, 1))

If you replace plot(type='l', ylim=c(-1, 1)) by spectro(x) you should
get what you want.

BUT computing AND displaying a spectrogram might be a slow process....
and I am afraid you will not be able to properly track your recording.
Anyway I will be happy to have a feedback if you try this option.

Best

Jerome
